title: We Saw Blue Origin's Rocket EXPLODE on the Launch Pad #space #rocket #jeffbezos #explosion

author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Blue Origin’s New Glenn explodes during a static fire test at the pad, potentially delaying NASA’s Moon Base timeline and Blue Moon lander missions. NASA reveals major lunar updates including the renaming of three CLPS flights to Moon Base I, II, and III, awards first-phase Lunar Terrain Vehicle contracts to Astrolab and Lunar Outpost, selects Blue Origin to deliver the rovers, taps Firefly for MoonFall drones, and confirms the Artemis III crew announcement is coming June 9th.

NASA also orders six additional Crew Dragon missions from SpaceX - does this effectively sideline Boeing’s Starliner for the rest of the ISS program? Plus, Virgin Galactic resumes glide flights with VSS Unity, Webb discovers a 50-million-solar-mass black hole in the early universe, Russia maneuvers satellites near a commercial ICEYE spacecraft, Varda’s W-4 mission fails, China prepares the reusable CZ-12B, and we cover the latest launches including Shenzhou-23; plus next week’s schedule.
